decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit had its own page through 2019 and fits the firm's core equipment line, so keeping it costs little while its construction-market prospects play out.
This second injection unit was also featured on its own page and shares components and service with the core range, so the option is cheap to hold and has shown no signal of failure.
Automatic airless guns are a core accessory with recurring spare-parts demand, and their sustained own-page presence suggests the value is being realized.
A manual airless gun is a staple item that supports pump sales, costs little to keep and has consistently been presented as its own product.
The air-assisted airless gun broadens finishing applications at low marginal cost, and nothing in its record indicates it should be abandoned.

The data logger dropped from its own page to a mere mention in 2019, a weak signal that its value is uncertain, but digital monitoring is still a growing area and the option is cheap to keep open a while longer.
